name: Medovy pogrebok
source:
Dive into a wonderful new world of furry eroge and fantasy, filled with lots of mysterious secrets. Help uncover them by engaging with characters who are ready to give you an enthusiastic tour of the enigmatic island of Kelrarium!

[Translated and edited from [url=https://vkplay.ru/play/game/kelrarioom-40188/]VK Play[/url]]
translation:
潜入一个充满毛茸茸的工口游戏和幻想的奇妙新世界，里面充满了许多神秘的秘密。与准备带你热情游览神秘的凯拉瑞姆岛的角色互动，帮助你揭开谜底！
